page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.i5 family, utilizing the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

A primary characteristic of this instance is its integrated local storage, which consists of 15,358 GB of SSD capacity. This bundled storage is complemented by a baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU hardware.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i5.16xlarge offers high resource density by combining substantial memory capacity with a large local SSD storage footprint on a single dedicated-core instance. This hardware profile is designed for workloads requiring high-throughput local storage and significant memory, such as large-scale databases, data warehousing, and intensive transactional processing systems.
